story: A four-rider breakaway formed immediately and built a maximum advantage of four minutes. Lidl-Trek and Q36.5 increased the pace on the main climb, distancing several sprinters, although Magnier rejoined on the descent. EF led the chase over the final hills, before Barré and Vauquelin attacked and bridged across to the breakaway. The escapees were caught with just over 10 kilometres remaining. Numerous attacks complicated the sprint preparation, despite Soudal Quick-Step's efforts to control proceedings. A major crash occurred inside the final kilometre, before Magnier claimed the sprint victory.
